description: Questions about the fictional Northwind Bank sample policies (make seed). Drafted from the ingested chunks; each answerable question names the page that answers it and an evidence phrase that run_eval.py verifies is on that page before running. Unanswerable questions check that the assistant says it could not find the answer.
